In 2025, the offering continued to expand its reach and impact, with three new partnership teams launching their work at the start of the year to join six ongoing teams already advancing complex energy initiatives. Together, these nine partnerships are developing custom strategies on issues ranging from energy affordability and grid modernization to transportation emissions and community resilience.
